_comment: Hand-corrections applied by lemma after automatic generation. Only lemmas already present in the deck are honoured, so an override can never add a card or shift a rank (card ids and review history are rank-based). Pronoun case-forms are written by hand because Wiktionary hangs the whole pronoun paradigm off one entry and the automatic lookup resolves them all to вы.

её.gloss: her, hers, its (possessive); her (accusative/genitive of она)

да.gloss: yes; (emphatic) indeed, well; (colloquial) and, but; let (да будет свет = let there be light)

того.gloss: that, of that (genitive/accusative of тот): для того, чтобы = in order to

том.gloss: that (prepositional of тот): в том доме = in that house; о том, что = about the fact that. Also a noun: volume (of a book)

всё.gloss: all, everything, the whole (neuter of весь); (adverb) all the time, still; that's all

клуб.gloss: club (a society, or a nightclub); also: a cloud or puff (of smoke, dust)

вас.gloss: you (plural or formal; genitive/accusative/prepositional of вы)

вам.gloss: to you (plural or formal; dative of вы)

вами.gloss: by/with you (plural or formal; instrumental of вы)

ему.gloss: to him, to it (dative of он)

нему.gloss: to him, to it (dative of он, after a preposition): к нему = to him

него.gloss: him, it (genitive/accusative of он, after a preposition): у него = he has; для него = for him

нём.gloss: him, it (prepositional of он): о нём = about him

нем.gloss: him, it (prepositional of он): о нём = about him. Written without ё; also нем = mute

им.gloss: to them (dative of они); by/with him, it (instrumental of он)

ним.gloss: by/with him, it (instrumental of он): с ним = with him; to them (dative of они after a preposition): к ним = to them

них.gloss: them (genitive/accusative/prepositional of они, after a preposition): у них = they have; о них = about them

ей.gloss: to her (dative of она); by/with her (instrumental of она)

ней.gloss: her (after a preposition): с ней = with her; о ней = about her

неё.gloss: her (genitive/accusative of она, after a preposition): у неё = she has; для неё = for her

нее.gloss: her (genitive/accusative of она, after a preposition): у неё = she has. Written without ё

чём.gloss: what (prepositional of что): о чём = about what

его.gloss: his, its (possessive); him, it (accusative/genitive of он)

ее.gloss: her, hers (possessive); her (accusative/genitive of она). Same word as её, written without ё

тому.gloss: to that (dative of тот): тому назад = ago

тем.gloss: by/with that (instrumental of тот); in set phrases: тем не менее = nevertheless, тем более = all the more

тома.gloss: volumes (plural of том); of a volume (genitive singular)

всему.gloss: to all, to everything (dative of весь/всё)

всём.gloss: all, everything (prepositional of весь/всё): во всём = in everything

само.gloss: itself (neuter of сам): само собой разумеется = it goes without saying

самое.gloss: the very, the most (neuter of самый): самое главное = the main thing; also: itself (neuter of сам)

самом.gloss: the very; self (prepositional of самый/сам): в самом деле = in fact, really

то.gloss: that (neuter of тот); then, in если … то … (if … then …)

чем.gloss: than; instead of, rather than; by/with what (instrumental of что)

было.gloss: was; there was (neuter past of быть); also a particle: almost, was about to (я было пошёл = I was about to go)

были.gloss: were; there were (plural past of быть)

селе.gloss: village (prepositional of село): в селе = in the village

моем.gloss: in my (prepositional of мой): в моём доме = in my house; also: we wash (present tense of мыть)

дам.gloss: I will give (future of дать); also: of ladies (genitive plural of дама)

виду.gloss: view, sight (in set phrases): иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind; ввиду = in view of

чтоб.gloss: so that, in order to (colloquial short form of чтобы)

ребят.gloss: guys, kids, lads (genitive plural of ребята)

сможешь.gloss: you will be able to (future of смочь, the perfective of мочь)

придётся.gloss: it will be necessary, you will have to (future of прийтись): мне придётся = I will have to

хватить.gloss: to be enough, to suffice (хватит! = that's enough!); (colloquial) to grab, to snatch
